# Native archive fixtures

The two `.7z` files embedded as base64 in JSON were generated by 7-Zip CLI
`7zz` 26.04 using the `source` commands in each fixture. They each contain one
1 MiB payload and record its expected SHA-256. The first exercises patterned
solid LZMA2 output; the second exercises the distance-one LZMA2 match case.

`encrypted_zip.json` was generated with 7zz 26.04 using WinZip AES-256. Its
password is a fixed test-only string and the fixture records the expected
payload digest. The regression runner decodes these archives locally; it does
not invoke a system 7zz executable.
